title: Effect of New Insurance Coverage Limits on Cancer Patients and Their Treatments
what_it_is: Effect of New Insurance Coverage Limits on Cancer Patients and Their Treatments

sections.label: Cancer drug price reductions
sections.summary: Since the 2021 announcement, an average price reduction of 30% was secured, with over 60% for some cancer drugs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Since we announced the changes in 2021, we have managed to secure an average price reduction of 30%.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: For some cancer drugs, the price reduction achieved was over 60%.

sections.label: CDL coverage and updates
sections.summary: The current CDL covers about 90% of public sector treatments and is updated every four months.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: The current CDL covers some 90% of treatments used in the public sector and is updated every four months to keep up with medical advancements and latest clinical evidence.

sections.label: Measures for exceptional cancer patients
sections.summary: MOH will put in place measures for the small number of exceptional cancer patients needing non-CDL treatments affected by policy changes.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: In this transitional period, MOH will put in place measures for the small number of exceptional cancer patients who require non-CDL treatments and are affected by the policy changes.

sections.label: Intent to lower cancer drug prices
sections.summary: The whole intent is to lower cancer drug prices, and competition is the best safeguard against profiteering.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Actually, the whole intent of this is to make sure that cancer drug prices are lowered and the best safeguard against profiteering is competition.

sections.label: Process deadlines and funding decision
sections.summary: Key process deadlines are online, and it usually takes about five months from submission to the funding decision.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: The key process deadlines have been put up online and it usually takes about five months from submission until the funding decision.

sections.label: ACE parallel evaluation process
sections.summary: Since January 2021, ACE established a process with the pharmaceutical industry to evaluate cancer treatments for subsidy and MediShield Life in parallel with HSA approval.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Since January 2021, ACE has also established a new process in consultation with the pharmaceutical industry to enable cancer treatments to be evaluated for subsidy and MediShield Life, in parallel with HSA's regulatory approval process.

sections.label: IP insurer approval and claims
sections.summary: IP insurers must seek MOH approval for changes in terms and conditions, and MAS will act against insurers for non-payment or unfair claims handling.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: IP insurers have to seek approval from MOH for any changes in terms and conditions and MAS will take action against insurers if they do not pay claims in accordance with the policy terms and conditions that they have agreed to or if there is any unfair handling of claims.

sections.label: CDL cancer drug coverage
sections.summary: CDL covers around 90% of cancer drug treatments used in PHIs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Nonetheless, we have looked at this and CDL actually covers around 90% of cancer drug treatments used in PHIs.

sections.label: Private sector drug price feasibility
sections.summary: Applying negotiated drug prices to private clinics depends on price controls, drug company agreement, and further study.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: The challenge is, private clinics have varied business models and pricing arrangements.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: So, the feasibility of applying negotiated drug prices to the private sector really depends on whether price controls can be introduced to ensure cost-savings are passed on to the patients.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: This is also subject to the agreement by the drug companies.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: This is something that will require further study.
